All four are correct: Indian Railways has 70,000+ route km, broad gauge is over 95% of it, and it is the 4th largest network in the world and the 2nd largest under a single management.
All four are correct: 99.6% of broad gauge (69,873 RKM) was electrified as of 23 May 2026, 14 of the 18 zones are at 100%, and Mission 100% targets full electrification by end-2026.
